metadata.title: chore: remove pii filter plugin tests
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
## Summary
- remove the dedicated `pii_filter` unit test package from this repo
- remove the unit-test fixture and unit-test expectations that still assumed `PIIFilterPlugin` loaded from this repo
- leave repo/plugin/perf config entries intact

## Verification
- `uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins/framework/test_manager.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins/plugins/test_init_hooks_plugins.py -q`
  - still fails only on other missing optional external `cpex_*` packages (`cpex_rate_limiter`, `cpex_retry_with_backoff`, `cpex_secrets_detection`, `cpex_url_reputation`)
- `rtk grep -n "cpex_pii_filter|PIIFilterPlugin" tests/unit tests/integration`
  - returns no matches

## Notes
- corrected scope after restoring non-test changes
- standard detailed code review workflow has not been run in this task yet

reviews.author: msureshkumar88
reviews.body:
# PR #4333 - APPROVED ✅

**PR:** https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/pull/4333  
**Title:** CHORE: REMOVE PII FILTER PLUGIN TESTS  
**Status:** ✅ APPROVED FOR MERGE  
**Date:** 2026-04-20

---

## Verification Results

### ✅ Tests Working in cpex-plugins
- **Location:** `cpex-plugins/plugins/rust/python-package/pii_filter/tests/test_plugin.py`
- **Result:** **26/26 tests PASSED** (100% success rate, 0.28s)
- **Coverage:** All plugin functionality tested (initialization, prompt hooks, tool hooks, edge cases)

### ✅ Tests Removed from mcp-context-forge
- No PII filter test implementations remain
- Only stale `__pycache__` directory (cosmetic cleanup opportunity)
- Remaining references are appropriate framework/integration tests

### ✅ Migration Complete
- Clean separation of concerns achieved
- Test infrastructure fully functional
- No regression in test coverage
- Follows best practices for plugin externalization

---

## Recommendation

**✅ APPROVE AND MERGE**

The PII filter plugin tests have been successfully migrated to cpex-plugins with 100% test pass rate. All unit tests are working in the new location, and no test implementations remain in mcp-context-forge.

---

**Detailed review:** See `pr-4333-review-approval.md`
